notes: The apodosis waw takes the complementizer 'that' the ASV writes for it under rule 14's open connective list; no הָיָה frame stands in the verse for rule 45 to place it.
אָצְרוּ takes the light-verb idiom 'have laid up in store' whole, headed on 'store' under rule 44.
בָּבֶלָה divides into the name and its directive he, which takes the written 'to' under rule 32.
לֹא … דָּבָר → 'nothing' is retained as rule 35's fusion, headed on the negative.
